ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Social Services Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota social services fraud scandal, including the entities and individuals involved.
questions: Who are the main entities and individuals involved in the scandal?
How did the fraud occur and what were the mechanisms used to carry it out?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover the full extent of the scandal and identify the key players involved.
